s.how: Soften 2 sliced onions, add 2 tbsp tomato paste, a pinch of cinnamon and chilli and a splash of water and cook down. Simmer 8 franks for 5 minutes. Put in steamed buns with spicy mustard and the onions and wrap in paper.

s.note: his flat in the Village and the bar down the street
s.how: Toss 300g mixed nuts with 30g melted butter, chopped rosemary and salt and roast at 170C for 12 minutes. Warm 250g olives in olive oil with strips of orange peel. Serve both in bowls.

m.how: Flour and brown 1kg chicken thighs. Make a dark roux in the pan with 40g butter and 3 tbsp flour, add 2 sliced onions and 500ml stock. Simmer the chicken in the gravy for 40 minutes. Serve over 300g rice with kale braised with garlic.

w.how: Mix 250g crushed biscuits with 100g melted butter and press into a tin. Beat 750g cream cheese with 200g sugar, 3 eggs and 150g sour cream. Bake in a water bath at 150C for an hour, cool in the oven and chill overnight.

d.note: a drink in a Village bar
d.how: For each drink, shake 45ml bourbon, 25ml lemon juice and 15ml sugar syrup with ice. Strain over fresh ice and top with a cherry. Makes four. Right on.
